calendarFaqs.q: When is the first day of school for LWSD in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The tentative calendar lists Monday, August 30, 2027, for grades 1-12 and Thursday, September 2, for kindergarten.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Spring Break for LWSD in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The tentative calendar lists Spring Break for April 10-14, 2028.
